text:
QUOTE: The health monitor never runs user code on its own thread. `monitor_loop` pushes events onto `event_queue_`, and `process_events()` swaps the queue out under `event_mutex_` and invokes the callbacks on the engine thread after releasing the lock (`health_monitor.cpp:118`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the monitor queues events under a mutex and the callbacks are invoked by the draining caller on the engine thread, not the monitor thread.
